metadata.methods_description: Intracranial electrophysiological recordings were collected during a delayed free recall task with open-loop stimulation at encoding. Stimulation was delivered to single electrodes in hippocampus and entorhinal cortex during alternating two-word blocks (6 of 12 words per list). Stimulation commenced 200 ms prior to word onset and lasted 4.6 seconds, ending 200-450 ms after the offset of the second word. Stimulation parameters included amplitude, pulse frequency, pulse width, and pulse count. Recordings were acquired using Blackrock (250 nV units) and Medtronic (0.1 µV units) systems. Monopolar recordings were referenced (typically mastoid) and bipolar recordings followed paired electrode schemes. MNI and Talairach coordinates were provided when available.
